issue_title: CSV export alters cell values that contain special characters
issue_body: Exporting a table to CSV changes the contents of cells that include characters such as &, <, >, or non-ASCII text: the exported values no longer match what is stored. Cells with only plain alphanumeric text come through unchanged.
prompt: Exporting a table to CSV changes the contents of cells that include characters such as &, <, >, or non-ASCII text: the exported values no longer match what is stored. Cells with only plain alphanumeric text come through unchanged.
expected_behavior: CSV values are written verbatim â€” no HTML entity encoding in standard CSV output.
Values containing commas, quotes, and newlines follow RFC 4180 quoting rules.
Non-ASCII characters are preserved without escaping.
Column order and Content-Disposition header are unchanged.
